title: Parent-Child Chunking
summary: Retrieve precise child passages, then expand them into bounded parent context that preserves meaning, provenance, and access boundaries.
overview: Parent-child chunking separates the unit optimized for retrieval from the unit supplied for interpretation. Small child chunks make individual facts easier to match; a larger parent section restores definitions, exceptions, or surrounding procedure steps. Stable child-to-parent relationships let the retriever find a precise passage without forcing the model to reason from a context fragment.

Parent expansion is not permission to attach an entire document. The system should select the smallest coherent parent, deduplicate siblings, and enforce a token budget. Parent and child records must share version lineage; otherwise a retrieved child can be explained using a different revision. Access control also applies to the expanded parent.

production.poc: A prototype compares passage-only answers with section-expanded answers on questions requiring nearby definitions or exceptions.
production.production: Production stores explicit lineage, source offsets, section hierarchy, and authorization metadata for both levels.
production.scale: At scale, use bounded expansion policies, update parent-child sets atomically where possible, and measure expansion usefulness against context cost.

components.name: Document structure parser
components.role: Recognizes sections, tables, headings, and source offsets.

components.name: Child vector index
components.role: Stores focused passages optimized for similarity retrieval.

components.name: Parent content store
components.role: Preserves coherent sections with document and version identity.

components.name: Expansion resolver
components.role: Fetches authorized parent context and deduplicates overlapping children.

components.name: Context budgeter
components.role: Chooses the useful portion of each parent within the prompt allocation.

flow.title: Parse structure
flow.description: Extract meaningful document boundaries instead of relying exclusively on character counts.

flow.title: Create lineage
flow.description: Assign children to versioned parents and retain precise source positions.

flow.title: Retrieve children
flow.description: Search small passages under the request’s access and freshness constraints.

flow.title: Resolve parents
flow.description: Fetch matching parent revisions and reject missing or unauthorized expansions.

flow.title: Deduplicate and trim
flow.description: Merge sibling hits and preserve the relevant subsection plus necessary definitions.

flow.title: Cite the evidence
flow.description: Present source pointers that distinguish the matched passage from the broader explanatory section.

diagrams.caption: Children identify relevant evidence; parent expansion restores only the context needed to interpret it.

useCase.title: Interpreting a procedure exception
useCase.situation: A maintenance assistant helps technicians locate approved inspection instructions.
useCase.problem: A retrieved sentence gives a torque value but omits the nearby exception for a specific component revision.
useCase.requirement: Return the value together with the procedure conditions and source revision.
useCase.architecture: Manual sections form parents; individual steps and notes form indexed children.
runtime: The query matches a torque-value child passage.
Expansion includes the enclosing procedure and its applicability note before a cited answer is drafted.
useCase.failure: If the matching parent revision is unavailable, the assistant withholds the procedure answer and links the verified manual location.
useCase.impact: Measure applicability accuracy and evidence coverage against prompt size; operational benefit comes from preserving conditions, not merely retrieving more text.

tradeoffs.cost: Consume tokens and can introduce distractors.
Requires format-specific extraction and quality checks.

failures.recovery: Require matching lineage and rebuild the inconsistent chunk set.
Authorize expanded sections independently or split the parent.

mistakes.fix: Expand to the smallest useful coherent section.

mistakes.mistake: Duplicating one parent for every child hit
mistakes.fix: Deduplicate parent context while preserving child evidence markers.
Use document structure to retain applicable labels and units.

whenToUse: Use for manuals, policies, and structured long documents.
Use when facts depend on nearby exceptions.
Use when small chunks retrieve well but answer poorly.
whenNotToUse: Avoid expansion for already self-contained short records.
Do not mix parent and child source revisions.
Avoid parents spanning unrelated security classifications.
